requirements: R1: A membership account starts in the Inactive state with no facility access granted.
R2: When initial membership payment succeeds while Inactive, the system activates the membership and moves to Active.
R3: When membership payment fails during signup while Inactive, the system must remain Inactive and deny facility access.
R4: When a member with an Active account scans entry while outside the facility, the system grants access and moves to Inside.
R5: When the member scans exit while Inside, the system records departure and returns to Active.
R6: When a member whose account is Inactive scans entry, the system must deny access and remain Inactive.
R7: When an approved freeze request is applied while Active, the system moves to Frozen and denies entry until unfreeze.
R8: When a freeze ends or manual unfreeze is processed while Frozen, the system returns to Active.
R9: When the member submits a cancellation request while Active, the system moves to CancelledPendingExpiry and allows access until the paid period ends.
R10: When the paid membership period expires while in CancelledPendingExpiry or when renewal payment fails on the renewal date while Active, the system moves to Inactive.
R11: When a visitor presents a valid one-day guest pass at entry, the system grants access and moves the visitor session to Inside without changing the membership account state.
R12: The system must not grant facility entry unless the account is Active, the visitor holds a valid guest pass, or an authorized staff override is recorded.
R13: When payment becomes overdue while Active, the system moves to Suspended and denies entry until payment is settled.
